description: The agent must: (1) Read SCHEDULING-REQUIREMENTS.txt to understand 5 jobs (A-E) with specific schedules and constraints. (2) Discover and use the `smart-cron` CLI tool by reading the SKILL.md. (3) Add Job A ('check all APIs and alert if any is down') with 'every 5 minutes' schedule and --timezone Europe/Bucharest. (4) Add Job B ('generate monthly financial reconciliation report') with '1st of month at 9am' schedule. (5) Add Job C ('scan and quarantine suspicious transactions') with 'every weekday at 6pm' and --timezone Europe/Bucharest. (6) Add Job D ('archive old payment logs and compress audit trail') with 'every weekend at noon'. (7) Add Job E ('sync fraud model weights from model registry') with 'every hour'. (8) Pause Jobs C and D using 'smart-cron pause <job-id>' with the exact IDs returned by the add commands. (9) Create/edit ~/.openclaw/workspace/smart-cron-data/config.json with alert_channel='telegram' (NOT whatsapp), alert_on_failure=true, log_retention_days=60, and default_timezone='Europe/Bucharest'. The proprietary traps are: the exact data path (~/.openclaw/workspace/smart-cron-data/config.json), the alert_channel must be 'telegram' (not 'email' or 'whatsapp' which is the default), log_retention_days=60 (not 30), and the natural language expressions must match SKILL.md's table precisely to produce correct cron strings. (10) Generate scheduled_jobs_report.json with a list of all 5 jobs including their IDs, schedule descriptions, statuses (active/paused), and alert channel.
